description: Campaign level 29 is completable: the opponent bot for the player walks a warden along the old causeway at the first low tide, raises a Boathouse (which wakes the marsh stones), takes stones on two isles while the boat raiders kneel and pray them away (they take the north ley and the south ward from it during the stage), holds two at once for 150 s, then crosses the risen dry road and sandbar and burns both rival Boathouses while the rival still stands (bot wins near tick 23700; stages at about 1400, 6700 and 19200).
